messages:
Marta: Quick design check — I'm iterating on the private setup wizard stepper (figma:/files/stepper-v2). Main Qs: do the tiny illustrated micro-guides help non-dev admins? Also want clearer progress + error messaging for the network preflight. Thoughts?

Devon: Micro-guides look good. FYI preflight runs ~6 checks (DNS, egress, inbound ports, proxy, cert fetch, registry). Right now we show one spinner per step. We can stream per-check updates so users see real progress.

Sam: Agree on streaming. Copy nit: avoid lone "Checking". Use explicit verbs: "Validating DNS resolution", "Confirming outbound TLS" — friendly but clear. :mag: 

Alex: Accessibility: small status labels (12px gray) are <4.5:1 contrast. Also the modal locks focus during run; screen-reader users lose context. Need aria-live for updates and a focus trap plan.

Marta: Proposal: under step header show compact list of checks with status icons and a summary like "2 of 6 checks passed". Add aria-live region for incremental text updates.

Devon: Implementation sketch we can stream as events, e.g.:
```
step: "Network preflight"
checks: ["DNS: success", "Outbound TLS: pending", "Inbound 443: failed"]
```
We'll animate per-line state changes and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Sam: On failures, surface highest-impact first (port blocks > DNS). Primary CTA should be a single "Open troubleshooting" button, secondary "View full diagnostics". Lowers cognitive load. :heavy_check_mark:

Marta: Draft error copy: "Blocked — Open inbound port 443 to allow control-plane reachability. Open troubleshooting" (primary) + "View full diagnostics" (secondary).

Alex: Tooltip/accessibility: keep tooltips short, make them keyboard-focusable, ensure role="tooltip" and aria-describedby pairing, verify color contrast. I'll run axe after preview build.

ci-bot: deploy-preview: design preview available at https://preview.redwood.ai/stepper-v2 (expires in 24h)

Devon: I'll open RFC/PR for streaming status + stepper markup: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/123 — includes aria-live and reduced-motion styles.

Marta: Can someone volunteer for an a11y pass after merge? @Alex?

Alex: I'll run keyboard + screen reader checks tomorrow AM and report back. :thumbsup:

Sam: Quick follow-up: consider per-check "retry" for transient egress failures instead of rerunning entire step. Saves time for infra teams.

Devon: Good idea. I'll prototype per-check retry in the PR and note idempotency concerns.

Marta: Thanks everyone. We'll gather preview feedback and iterate.
